attempted_claim: Let N>=2, d>=2, let M_{d,N}=End_{d,N}/PGL_{N+1} be the coarse moduli space of degree-d endomorphisms of P^N over C, and let eL_bif be the geometric bifurcation adelic line bundle on M_{d,N} of Yuan-Zhang as in Ji-Xie Section 6.4, with deg_{eL_bif}(C)=eL_bif . C for an irreducible algebraic curve C in M_{d,N}. Let C be an irreducible algebraic curve not contained in the Lattes locus. Is deg_{eL_bif}(C)>0? Equivalently, does every non-isotrivial one-parameter algebraic family of degree-d endomorphisms of P^N lying over C have nonempty bifurcation locus, i.e. is no such family stable?
decisive_failure: No part of the target positivity claim is established. The N=1 rigidity ingredients do not transfer to N>=2 because the critical locus is positive-dimensional, and the Lyapunov-minimizer characterization of Lattes maps requires global minimality that constancy along one curve cannot supply. The explicit test family is non-isotrivial but its bifurcation degree remains undecided. Working notes and the reproducible multiplier script are retained in output/WORKLOG.md and output/artifacts/recovery_test.py.
